inputs.text: [excited] Jig… ah… no… toh… saurus. [curious] Three pieces, all Greek. [pauses] "Giga" means giant — like in "gigantic." "Noto" means south.
[proud] The giant lizard of the south.
[warmly] There you go. It lived in Argentina, [amazed] ninety-eight million years ago, [pauses] with Andesaurus for a neighbor — a giant with a long neck.
